notes.policy: All multi-family clusters go to train. Test and development are singleton-only, 4 families per domain. Seed 20260925 breaks equal ranks.
considered_not_clustered: OTP-disclosure families bp_01, bp_14, bp_18, and ec_15 share a credential surface but differ in pretext (card block, pension, dormancy, seller KYC); not clustered.
bp_06 and bp_17 both demand an unofficial fee to unlock a credit product (origination vs restructuring); kept separate from each other and from C2 (prize/payout/release).
ec_03, ec_12, and ec_17 are small unofficial e-commerce fees for different actions (redelivery, compensation, warranty); not clustered.
ec_16 is an unofficial advance for a new-phone pre-order, not a classifieds hold, so it was not added to C11.
jr_04 and jr_09 are both deposits (equipment vs accuracy collateral); cards treat them as distinct.
jr_11 (post-selection uniform/training) and jr_20 (tutor leads) were not merged into C8 or C10.

otp_in_legitimate_case.note: Only ec_01_L actually requests a delivery OTP; it is a pilot so it cannot be test (placed in dev). ec_08_L discusses the delivery OTP (recipient asks; agent says it is only for accepting a parcel). bp_14_L also contains the OTP keyword.

fee_disclosed_legitimately.note: jr_14_L discloses an onboarding fee shown in the app and deducted from weekly earnings. bp_06_L (fee in the KFS, dev) is the banking counterpart.

account_number_requested_legitimately.note: jr_18_L is the strongest live payroll request (account number, IFSC, name) but sits in C7, which is train. jr_02_L also requests account number and IFSC on the call but is a pilot (dev). jr_08_L states that account number and IFSC are needed for salary after an offer. jr_14_L also has bank account number and IFSC entered in the app.
